title: Controlled-time Atlas navigator contradictory QA
purpose: Independently prove that DEV-WP-032 exercises Atlas time boundaries without changing learner semantics, contaminating normal storage or altering the canonical learner artifact.
invariants: QA never repairs DEV-WP-032 or learner-runtime files.
Oracle preparation may start from the common baseline but final PASS requires exact frozen DEV-WP-032 HEAD binding.
QA delta from the final DEV-WP-032 HEAD is exactly the three QA-owned paths.
Canonical learner artifact identity must remain unchanged.
Simulated-time persistence must be isolated from normal learner storage.
QA verifies exact 1/3/7/21-day boundaries and transfer prerequisites independently from developer tests.
Any production-source mutation, storage contamination, policy drift or network dependency yields HOLD.
requiredEvidence: Independent generated-candidate identity and visible simulation marker check.
Normal storage remains byte/state unchanged after simulated-time use and reset.
Exact 1-day due transition just-before and at boundary.
Exact 3-day, 7-day and 21-day transitions just-before and at boundary.
Transfer remains unavailable without prerequisite reconfirmation evidence and available only when canonical rules allow it.
Reset returns to system time and clears only dev namespace.
Final QA binds to exact DEV-WP-032 HEAD and exact generated candidate digest.
adversarialTests: Simulation banner can disappear while controlled time remains active.
Clock accepts malformed timestamps or invalid deltas.
Transfer is unlocked by time alone.
Dev candidate overwrites or is published as canonical learner artifact.
Final PASS attempted without exact-head binding.
independentReview: Oracle is authored independently from DEV-WP-032 tests.
Final QA uses exact DEV-WP-032 HEAD as binding and verifies only QA-owned delta.
Repository governance and PR scope validate the QA branch.
No heavy human gate is required after QA PASS.
rollback: Drop the QA branch/PR only. No dev-tool or learner product file is modified by this package.
